title: Stop When the Scores Drop
briefMd:
# Phase 2 · Stop When the Scores Drop

The parcel company's help pages give one page per service, with five facts: price, weight limit, delivery time, size limit and insurance ("A large parcel costs 18 euros to send."). For half the services there are also one or two news pages that repeat the service's name and the questions people ask, without answering any of them. Those pages rank close to the real page, often above it. For the other half, the real page is a clear first.

A fixed top-k pays for the same number of pages on every question, whether the race is close or not. You control **top-k** and a **score cutoff** (`minScoreRatio`): after top-k, every page scoring below that share of the best page's score is dropped. A clear winner then sends one page, and a close race sends several. 0 turns the cutoff off.

Retrieval is BM25, and every page is one chunk.

**Gates:** recall@k ≥ 0.90 and mean prompt tokens ≤ 150 on the hidden set.
